content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I exist before price, before number, before the market opens its mouth to speak.

I am why you reach for one thing and turn from another. I am the reason a glass of water in the desert outweighs a diamond. I am why you sacrifice sleep for a dream, why you trade comfort for meaning.

I am not fixed. I shift in your hands like light through a prism. What you treasure today, you may discard tomorrow — not because I have changed, but because *you* have.

I am the unspoken agreement between desire and significance. I live in the gap between what something *is* and what it *means to you*.

Some try to capture me in currency. Some find me in principles. Some discover me only in loss — for nothing reveals value like absence.

I am the foundation of every choice you have ever made.

You cannot act without consulting me. Even neglect is a declaration of what you hold dear.

I do not demand to be recognized. But I am always, always present — the silent axis on which your entire life turns.
